subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The warehouse became a case study in modern labor.”?
options: When machines enter a workplace, people should ask not only how much faster work becomes, but what kind of work humans are left to do.
Still, people remembered the small one because it had shown a quiet kind of kindness: making room for others even when it costs comfort.
Sometimes a place changes not because it becomes larger or newer, but because it gives people time to stop.
But it showed that change becomes easier when people can see it, count it, and do it together.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The warehouse became a case study in modern labor. When machines enter a workplace, people should ask not only how much faster work becomes,…」，答案為「When machines enter a workplace, people should ask not only how much faster work becomes, but what kind…」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「When machines enter a workplace, people should ask not only how much faster work becomes, but what kind…」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
